Transport Modes

开顶集装箱

A general term for containers without a fixed roof, including open-top and open-side containers, used for oversize, heavy, or irregular cargo that cannot fit standard containers.

Definition

A general term for containers without a fixed roof, including open-top and open-side containers, used for oversize, heavy, or irregular cargo that cannot fit standard containers.

Operational example

Open containers are frequently used to ship heavy machinery that cannot be loaded into standard containers due to height restrictions.

Localized term

开顶集装箱
